# netactuate_nke_cluster (Resource)

Manages a NKE Cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_cluster" "example" {
  contract_id   = 12345
  maximum_nodes = 1
  minimum_nodes = 1
  name          = "example"
  plan          = "vc-1"
  version       = "1.29"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contract_id` (Number) NKE billing contract ID. This is distinct from the server resource's package_billing_contract_id. Must be a usage-type contract.
- `maximum_nodes` (Number) Maximum number of nodes (autoscaling upper bound)
- `minimum_nodes` (Number) Minimum number of nodes (autoscaling lower bound)
- `name` (String) The name of the NKE cluster
- `plan` (String) Plan/package name for worker nodes (e.g. "VR2x2x25")
- `version` (String) The Kubernetes version. Use data.netactuate_nke_versions to list available versions.

### Optional

- `do_autoscaling` (Boolean) Enable autoscaling for this cluster
- `do_dual_stack` (Boolean) Enable dual-stack IPv4+IPv6 support (can only be set at creation, requires recreation to change)
- `kubernetes_dashboard` (Boolean) Install the Kubernetes dashboard addon (requires recreation)
- `location` (String) Location name where the cluster will be deployed (e.g. "DEVRDU - Raleigh, NC")
- `location_id` (Number) Location ID where the cluster will be deployed
- `pod_cidr` (String) Pod network CIDR for the cluster
- `replicas` (Number) Number of control plane replicas
- `service_cidr` (String) Service network CIDR for the cluster. Must be a /16: the platform supports no other prefix length.
- `tag_ids` (Set of Number) Tag IDs to assign to the cluster. Note: the API does not return tag IDs so changes made outside Terraform may not be detected
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID for worker node networking. Requires an applied outbound SNAT rule before cluster creation.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) The Kubernetes API server URL
- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the NKE cluster
- `high_availability` (Boolean) Whether the control plane has high availability (true when replicas > 1)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kubernetes_dashboard_url` (String) The Kubernetes dashboard URL (empty if dashboard addon not installed)
- `package_id` (Number) The resolved plan/package ID (populated after apply)
- `pod_network` (String) The pod network CIDR
- `prometheus_url` (String) The Prometheus metrics URL
- `service_network` (String) The service network CIDR
- `status` (String) The cluster status (e.g. "Healthy", "Initializing")

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_nke_cluster.example 12345
```
